notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands.
description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Ley Weaver.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Ley Weaver.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Ley Weaver.
Activate two mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping the lands.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Ley Weaver.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Ley Weaver.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Ley Weaver from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.
